title: Extra Rocks
description: A mod that adds multiple new stones and other geological related things.
body:
## Features
- **4 New stone types:** Shale, Gritstone, Limestone and Chalk. All found in the Overworld.
- **Complete Sets:** Every new stone features polished and brick variants, complete with matching stairs, slabs, and walls.
- **Vanilla Upgrades:** Completed the missing sets for Granite, Diorite, and Andesite by adding polished walls and brick variants (including stairs, slabs, and walls).
- **Coloured Chalk:** Express your creativity with 16 dyeable variants of standard Chalk!
- **Earthy Architecture:** Build with brand-new Polished Dirt and Dirt Bricks (full blocks only; no stairs, slabs, or walls).

## Recipes and Crafting
- **Stonecutter Exclusivity:** To keep the crafting UI clean, all new stone variants are **only** accessible via the Stonecutter.
- **Vanilla Consistency:** Polished walls for Granite, Diorite, and Andesite retain their classic vanilla crafting methods.
- **Dirt Crafting:** Polished Dirt and Dirt Bricks are made using standard brick recipes in the Crafting Table.

## Achievements
- **Rocks Galore!:** Collect all 10 overworld stones (Stone, Granite, Diorite, Andesite, Deepslate, Tuff, Shale, Gritstone, Limestone, and Chalk).
- **Dirt Palace:** Placing a Polished Dirt block.

## All blocks
<details>
<summary>Block List</summary>

**Shale Set:** Shale, Stairs, Slab, Wall | Polished, Polished Stairs, Polished Slab, Polished Wall | Bricks, Brick Stairs, Brick Slab, Brick Wall.

**Gritstone Set:** Gritstone, Stairs, Slab, Wall | Polished, Polished Stairs, Polished Slab, Polished Wall | Bricks, Brick Stairs, Brick Slab, Brick Wall.

**Limestone Set:** Limestone, Stairs, Slab, Wall | Polished, Polished Stairs, Polished Slab, Polished Wall | Bricks, Brick Stairs, Brick Slab, Brick Wall.

**Chalk Set:** Chalk, Stairs, Slab, Wall | Polished, Polished Stairs, Polished Slab, Polished Wall | Bricks, Brick Stairs, Brick Slab, Brick Wall.

**Coloured Chalk:** White, Light Grey, Grey, Black, Brown, Red, Orange, Yellow, Lime, Green, Cyan, Light Blue, Blue, Purple, Magenta, Pink.

**Dirt Set:** Polished Dirt, Dirt Bricks.

**Vanilla Additions:** Polished Granite/Diorite/Andesite Walls | Granite/Diorite/Andesite Bricks, Brick Stairs, Brick Slabs, Brick Walls.

</details>
